sloka: ते रावणवधं दृष्ट्वा देवगन्धर्वदानवाः ।जग्मुः स्वैस्वैर्विमानैस्ते कथयन्तः शुभाः कथाः ।। ६.११५.१ ।।
transliteration: te rāvaṇavadhaṁ dṛṣṭvā devagandharvadānavāḥ ।jagmuḥ svaisvairvimānaiste kathayantaḥ śubhāḥ kathāḥ ।। 6.115.1 ।।

translations.english: In the meantime, Devas, Gandharvas, Danavas speaking to each other an auspicious story of Ravana's destruction went in their respective aerial cars.
